releaseStatus: Manager 0.2.1-preview.4 is an unsigned Windows preview. The complete Loader, SDK and client bundle is not publicly released. Check Releases before downloading.

topics.title: Welcome to Modstoke
topics.summary: Free modding tools and a community for Sons of the Forest players, mod creators and server hosts, alongside Tithewood, our medieval roleplay game on BYOND. Developed by OpenACAI; independent of Endnight Games.
facts: Manager brings mod sources and setup management together in a Windows desktop app. Download the current release from Releases and follow the installation guide.

Loader and the SDK are being developed as an independent mod runtime, with compatibility identities for BepInEx, RedLoader and SonsSdk. This is a development direction, not a promise that every existing mod works.
Ask for setup help, share a mod idea, find a co-op crew, or tell us which player and creator problems matter most. All advertised Modstoke tools are free.

topics.title: What the SDK is being built to provide
topics.summary: The current development source provides typed game observations and mod services. These are source contracts, not a released SDK package or proof of in-game acceptance.
facts: Inventory and equipment snapshots; crafting recipe requirements and shortages; local-player survival vitals; season, weather and temperature observations.

Server-world player and vehicle observations, NPC state and construction requirements; bounded collision queries and loaded-terrain height/normal reads. These do not establish full cave collision or walkability coverage.
Owned audio and loaded asset-bundle inspection helpers, observed coroutine completion, UI draft fields and remote command responses. Server authorization and world-readiness checks still apply.

Native mod manifests can declare exact required IDs/versions. The runtime orders callbacks, blocks missing or cyclic requirements, and stops dependents after prerequisite failure. Dedicated-server initialization skips client menus and input.
Do not assume a stable public API, universal compatibility, higher player limits, automatic retries for uncertain commands, or that source/build success proves multiplayer behavior.

topics.title: Loader and native mods
topics.summary: Loader is the developing runtime for discovering native mod packages and hosting their lifecycle. The complete public Loader/SDK/client bundle is not released yet.
facts: Creator preparation covers package layout, manifest identity, assembly and entry type, dependency declarations, compatibility notes and an isolated development setup.
Use matching source revisions and record the exact game build. Do not mix arbitrary Loader, SDK and client revisions or treat legacy compatibility identities as a guarantee.
Manager's automatic full-bundle installation and a public Loader update manifest are not currently available. There is no new Loader download to recommend.

topics.title: Manager: start with the published preview
topics.summary: Modstoke Manager is the desktop starting point for browsing mod sources and managing a game setup. Current downloadable availability comes from the release index.
facts: Follow the installation guide, back up saves, and identify the correct game installation. Manager 0.3.0 and everything in its installer are signed by OpenACAI Inc.

Sign in to Nexus Mods through your browser from the Manager; personal API keys are no longer needed. The server browser opens modstoke:// join links, and dedicated server hosts get game settings, staff permissions and a live console.
The hosted mod catalog is still being prepared. The website does not currently serve a complete Loader/SDK/client bundle or an automatic update service.
For help, share the Manager and game versions, whether Loader/client are installed, the action attempted, and a short sanitized error excerpt. Never post tokens, passwords or full private logs.

topics.title: What we are working toward
topics.summary: The direction is a useful free toolchain connecting players, mod authors and server hosts. No release dates are promised here.
facts: Expand the typed SDK and independent runtime, preserve useful legacy compatibility, and develop shared mod UI and configuration services.
Prepare coherent Loader/SDK/client releases and clearer compatibility information. Only approved entries on the Releases page count as public downloads.
Build an opt-in public game-server directory and a welcoming Discord with setup support, member-created crew listings and creator discussion.
Admin is a host tool with private source. Its DLL is published on Nexus for server hosts; the website does not host it. Do not reveal internal administrative implementation.

topics.title: Find your next crew
topics.summary: Sons of the Forest is an open-world survival horror game with crafting, building, exploration, solo play and online co-op. Modstoke helps members arrange their own sessions.
facts: Use /crew list with optional region, style and when keyword filters. Time matching searches the host's written session time; it does not calculate overlapping schedules or convert timezones.

Use /crew create to offer a session with region, time plus timezone, playstyle, open spots and optional requirements. One active post per person; posts expire after six hours by default, with a one-to-24-hour choice.

Choose your region and playstyle with /roles. These are self-selected interests, not matchmaking guarantees. /crew alerts explicitly opts into DMs; optional region filtering and a one-alert-per-two-hours limit apply. Turn them off any time.

Use /servers to view opt-in public server listings. Crew posts are member plans, not reservations, verified compatibility, live player presence or an automatic game join. Agree game/mod versions and save expectations with the host.

topics.title: Tithewood · medieval roleplay on BYOND
topics.summary: Tithewood is our independently operated medieval roleplay game on BYOND, built from Ratwood. Its community is part of the Modstoke Discord.
facts: Players take character roles in a shared world with trades, farming, city guard duties and adventuring. Some roles have access requirements that depend on the game configuration.
The public website presents Grimoria with an inherited setting illustration. It is a world map for the setting, not a live gameplay map.

The public website reviewed on 2026-10-20 says public access is closed and no launch date is announced. Check tithewood.com for current access; do not assume a reachable service means a playable public round.
When access opens, follow the website for BYOND client and connection guidance. Use the official BYOND Windows client and your BYOND account; never share your password or private logs in Discord.

Choose Tithewood in the project role menu and use its dedicated discussion and development channels. Share ideas, report a clear reproduction with sanitized errors, and arrange play only when an actual session has been announced.
